scope: The genuine complete MIDP2 Jimm static initializer executes directly from each original input JAR in 1400 fresh isolated JVM class loaders per version. No application/API class, instruction, method or resource is rewritten and no fixture artifact is substituted. A real custom java.util.Properties installed in each probe process observes actual System.getProperty callbacks, returns explicit platform/profile/Sony strings, or throws actual SecurityException/AssertionError at one of three properties. US/Turkish default Locale, ten platforms, two profile values, five Sony values and seven failure cases are covered. Unsafe reads the actual partially initialized static fields without recursively initializing the class, including after uncaught initializer failure. Actual Timer instances are cancelled, System properties/Locale restored and loaders closed. Full property-read traces, eight shared bound scalar/string fields, Timer presence and actual completion/error classes are recorded. Native/raw JP8 fields have a separate matching 1400-row observation series; the optimized JP8 field is actually absent and is never invented or compared as an ABI. No pre-seeding static fields, synthetic predicate or physical-device/whole-program equivalence claim.
